title: Thrice-Greatest Hermes, Vol. 1
author: G. R. S. Mead
description: The first volume of G. R. S. Mead's study of Hermetic literature. It introduces the religious and philosophical setting of writings attributed to Hermes Trismegistus and their relationship with the spiritual world of late antiquity.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/thricegreatesthe01hermuoft).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
